description: Edge and branch sites: small clusters in shops, plants, branches and remote locations, deployed without local IT, managed and upgraded centrally, protected locally and at the core, and running local applications, AI included.

types.edge_cluster: Small clusters at the site, from one server to a few
types.central_view: Sites seen and managed from one central plane
types.local_copy: Local copies of the site's workloads, restorable without the network
types.core_replica: Copies of the site's workloads at a core site or in a cloud
types.edge_app: Applications that must run at the site, AI inference included
